title: The MacBook Neo Just Got Its Largest Discount Ever
gist: Apple's budget MacBook Neo got its largest-ever discount, $50 off to $649, after a price that had been unusually steady; the deal note says its 8 GB of memory and missing features make the MacBook Air worth it for heavy users, and mentions that Apple raised prices across the MacBook lineup in late June.

insights.claim: Apple's MacBook Neo fell from $699 to $649, its largest discount ever, after the previous best deal was just $10 off.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Price stickiness of Apple's budget laptop suggests solid demand; discounting timing signals holiday promotional intensity.

insights.claim: The MacBook Neo is Apple's first foray into truly budget-tier laptops, and its price has been steadier than any other MacBook in the lineup.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: A low-price Mac expands Apple's addressable market in education and entry-level PCs.
insights.locator: The MacBook Neo is on sale

insights.claim: Apple increased prices across its entire MacBook lineup in late June, before this November deal.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Broad Mac price hikes point to cost inflation (e.g., memory) and Apple's pricing power.
